name: beam-sdk-monorepo
description: Monorepo for BEAM SDK packages across Python, TypeScript, and Go.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @beam-network/sdk && npm run build -w @beam-network/cli && npm run build -w @beam-network/vscode && npm run build:web
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w @beam-network/web-sdk && npm run build -w @beam-network/web-sdk-server
scripts.test: npm run test:python && npm run test:typescript && npm run test:go && npm run test:rust
scripts.test:python: cd sdks/python && (python -m unittest discover -s tests || ../../python/.venv/bin/python -m unittest discover -s tests)
scripts.test:typescript: npm run test -w @beam-network/sdk && npm run test -w @beam-network/cli && npm run test -w @beam-network/vscode && npm run test:web
scripts.test:web: npm run test -w @beam-network/web-sdk && npm run test -w @beam-network/web-sdk-server
scripts.lint: npm run lint:python && npm run lint:typescript && npm run lint:go && npm run lint:rust
scripts.lint:python: cd sdks/python && (python -m ruff check beam_network_sdk || ../../python/.venv/bin/python -m ruff check beam_network_sdk)
scripts.lint:typescript: npm run lint -w @beam-network/sdk && npm run lint -w @beam-network/cli && npm run lint -w @beam-network/vscode && npm run lint:web
scripts.lint:web: npm run typecheck -w @beam-network/web-sdk && npm run typecheck -w @beam-network/web-sdk-server && eslint .
scripts.package:check: npm run package:check -w @beam-network/web-sdk && npm run package:check -w @beam-network/web-sdk-server
